plain_summary: The market is obsessed with bipedal humanoids, but the real embodied-AI windfall over 2-5 years accrues to established automation and logistics players whose installed hardware gets upgraded by AI vision models, plus the high-moat machine-vision and sensor suppliers that make it possible. 80/20 structural split; humanoid pure-play OEMs avoided. Central bet: the durable moat shifts UP-STACK from mechanical components (commoditized by Chinese scale) to sensing and software.
notes: Prices are recent-close anchors (web-verified June 2026), not lock-day official; live refresh job refines. Japanese best-in-class names (Keyence, Fanuc, Harmonic Drive, Nabtesco, SMC) EXCLUDED — not cleanly Fidelity-holdable; the vehicles-wrong risk made literal. CGNX is the load-bearing pillar by design.

Machine vision + warehouse installed base, cheaper than CGNX. FY26 9-13% guide. Caveat: vision sub-segment in cyclical downturn (EV/semi).
Cheapest up-stack sensing exposure (low-teens P/E). Powers CGNX 3900; Dragonwing IQ10 robotics chip. Robotics small vs smartphone core.
Only cleanly-holdable foreign name. CATALYST: 100% robotics spin-off to separate listing Q2 2026 = value unlock + future pure-play vehicle.
